# pai help

Explain a command (same as `pai <command> --help`)

```
pai help [COMMAND...]
```

Without arguments shows the overview. `pai help more` lists every command that is not a daily one.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `COMMAND...` | no | Command and optional subcommand, e.g. `session open` |

```sh
pai help
pai help open
pai help providers use
pai help more
```

See also: `pai doc`
